fields.description: Address Residences Dubai Hills Estate brings branded apartments and three-bedroom townhouses to a landscaped setting near the park and mall. Two towers share leisure spaces, with a rooftop garden and outdoor cinema adding places to unwind above the neighbourhood. One to three bedroom apartments offer different balcony arrangements and outlooks; the selected building and floor matter when comparing homes.

overview: The brochure describes Tower A with 18 floors and Tower B with 21, positioned to make use of park and district views. A residents’ lobby leads into homes designed around contemporary living, while the shared podium and roof spaces provide room for exercise and social time. Address branding is part of the published positioning, but a specific furnishing package, hotel service entitlement or management arrangement needs confirmation in the sale documents.
research.locationNote: The project is in Dubai Hills Estate, near Dubai Hills Park and Dubai Hills Mall, with the business park, schools and healthcare within the wider district. Al Khail Road provides city access. Brochure references to future Metro or rail connections are not confirmation of an operating station at the development.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.93m. The August 2024 launch overview lists AED 1.93m, AED 2.77m and AED 3.97m starts for one, two and three bedrooms. Current prices, townhouse terms and stock require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% on completion. August 2026 and October 2027 are 5% stages. Obtain the selected unit’s current outstanding schedule.
research.handoverNote: February 2029 is the launch estimate and Property Finder’s reported delivery date. Confirm the current contractual programme.

facts.label: Published apartment mix
facts.value: The launch overview lists 256 one-bedroom, 250 two-bedroom and 69 three-bedroom apartments: 575 apartments. It does not separately quantify townhouses.

facts.label: Tower A podium access
facts.value: Three-bedroom A111 on level one is marked with podium access and a published total of 1,650 sq ft. The upper-floor A.4 layout is printed at 1,527 sq ft. Figures are rounded in this plan pack, so use the contractual unit schedule for precise areas.

facts.label: Townhouse area is unresolved
facts.value: Bayut gives approximately 1,688 sq ft for a townhouse, while Property Finder includes that size within Tower B’s three-bedroom apartment range. Without an identified townhouse plan, that figure is not used as a verified townhouse size.
